subject: Discovery: Observability & Evals for LLM inference

From: Olivia Carter <olivia.carter@fintechai.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-14T15:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Discovery: Observability & Evals for LLM inference

Thanks for the meeting earlier, Marissa — that was helpful. A couple of clarifying items from our side before we align internally: 

- Primary pain: we need to detect prompt/regression drift quickly. Our current monitoring is basic metrics (latency, error rate) but no prompt-level quality signals.
- Stack today: in-house orchestration on AWS EKS, models served from a managed endpoint (mix of hosted + self-hosted), Postgres for logs, Datadog for infra metrics.
- Success criteria: automated alerting for behavioral regressions, a dashboard showing per-prompt pass/fail on golden sets, and a low-friction rollout guardrail for safe model switchovers.

We want to confirm Redwood can: provide tracing hooks to capture prompts + metadata, host golden prompt set evaluations with regression alerts, and integrate dashboards with our existing Datadog/Looker set up. Also need to know what observability data is stored and for how long (retention) for compliance.

I'll get procurement timelines and SOC 2 questionnaire back to you by EOD.

—Olivia
Olivia Carter
Head of Platform
FinTechAI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Carter <olivia.carter@fintechai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-14T16:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Discovery: Observability & Evals for LLM inference

Hi Olivia — great to meet you and the platform team. Recap below from our discussion + proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. I kept this focused on observability + evals per your ask.

Quick summary of what we heard (pain points):
- No prompt-level quality telemetry: you can't quickly detect when a model drifts for a critical prompt.
- Alert noise: infra alerts are high-signal but ML-quality regressions are lost in the noise.
- Risky rollouts: current rollout process involves manual smoke checks and engineers on-call during every model swap.

Current stack (as stated): AWS EKS orchestration, mixed model hosting (hosted endpoints + some self-hosted), Postgres logs, Datadog for infra.

Success criteria (what success looks like in 90 days):
- Golden prompt sets evaluated automatically after each model push, with pass/fail results surfaced.
- Tracing hooks that capture + index prompt/context/metadata (PII redaction options) for root-cause investigations.
- Dashboard(s): per-prompt trend lines, black-box score distributions, and top regressions (by severity).
- Regression alerts: configurable thresholds that notify SRE/ML owners and trigger an automatic rollback guardrail if a critical prompt fails.

What Redwood can deliver (proposal at a glance):
- Tracing hooks: lightweight SDK snippets + HTTP hook options to stream prompt + metadata to our observability plane. Hooks support field-level redaction before ingestion.
- Golden-set evaluations: support for uploading CSV/JSON prompt sets; scheduled or post-deploy evaluations; typical run times < 10min for 500 prompts on our Dedicated pools.
- Dashboards: prebuilt dashboards (Datadog/Looker export templates) + deep link tiles you can embed.
- Rollout guardrails: policy-driven canary analyses with automatic rollback on configurable failure criteria.

Open questions / items we need from FinTechAI:
1) Representative golden prompt set (top 150 prompts across billing flows).
2) Desired alerting cadence and escalation list (who to page vs. who to notify).
3) Retention target for observability traces (we offer default 90d; enterprise retention available).

Proposed immediate next steps:
- We will share a 1-page technical integration checklist and an eval template by EOD (attached).
- Rishi (cc'd) will schedule a 60-minute technical sync next week to walk through tracer integration and datashapes.
- Olivia to share golden prompt CSV + SOC2 questions doc; we'll reply with a short mapping of observability artifacts to SOC controls.

Attachments: redwood_post_call_recap.pdf (this recap + short integration checklist)
Links: https://hubspot.com/deal/FinTechAI-RF-2026-0247 (deal record)

If that all looks right, we'll lock the technical sync time after you confirm availability. Thanks again — excited to work together.

Best,

Marissa Cole
